review_text: By far the worst hot Americano I've ever had at a pick-up stand. Plus, the server was pretty unfriendly.
Their coffee tastes so good. Every time I go there, I'm tempted to buy more. But every time I buy more, their coffee tastes the same.
We noticed that when we went to the ecoland branch, even though we ordered an upsize, it was only half full. We haven't drunk the one in the picture yet. We just ordered the regular one
